title: fix(mcp): send the audio emotion/style instruction as `instructions`
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16615

- Renames the audio tool's `instruct` parameter to `instructions`, the query parameter gen's `/audio` endpoint reads. The value now passes straight through; before, gen never received it.
- Adds one regression test in `packages/mcp/test/audioService.test.js`: it validates the arguments against the tool schema, as the MCP server does, then checks the request URL.
- Verified: the test fails on `main` and passes with the fix; `npm test` in `packages/mcp` passes 23/23.

_Found and fixed by Ribbert; manually refreshed and verified with Codex. Simplified in review to a parameter rename._

gist.headline: Audio takes the hint
gist.blurb: The MCP audio tool gets the memo about emotion and style. Its instructions make it all the way to the audio endpoint instead of quietly disappearing en route.
gist.summary: Renames the MCP audio tool’s `instruct` query parameter to `instructions`, which gen’s `/audio` endpoint reads, and adds a schema-to-request regression test.
gist.impact: Emotion and style instructions supplied through the MCP audio tool reach `/audio` instead of being ignored.
